description: This file implements a TCP socket server class 'SocketServer' with methods for opening a socket, accepting connections, sending and receiving messages, and managing the server thread. It also defines related data structures and enums for communication protocol, including message headers and command IDs.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message with a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server capable of handling client connections, sending/receiving protocol messages, and managing server lifecycle.

methods.name: Response()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing channel_id to 0 and json to empty.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t, const string&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specified channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: SocketServer()
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket descriptors and state variables.

methods.name: ~SocketServer()
methods.description: Destructor that closes the server and client sockets.

methods.name: Open(const string&, int, const function<void (const Response&)>&)
methods.description: Sets up the server socket, binds, and starts listening on specified address and port.

methods.name: RunThread()
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server loop.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections and processing incoming messages.

methods.name: Close()
methods.description: Closes server and client sockets, stops server loop.

methods.name: ReadExact(uint8_t*, int)
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket.

methods.name: SendInvoke(uint32_t, const string&, const string&)
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with headers, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach(uint32_t, bool)
methods.description: Sends an attach command with channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit()
methods.description: Sends an exit command to the client.

methods.name: ReadResponse(Response&)
methods.description: Reads a response message header and payload from the client.
